posts.text:
President Trump is right to strengthen the public charge rule.

And it's a disgrace that blue states & Mayor Mamdani are suing to stop it.

Our immigration system should prioritize people who can support themselves--not provide welfare paid for by Arkansas taxpayers to migrants.
posts.summary: Supports Trump public charge rule, opposes blue state legal challenges
